scientific_review: Internal review distinguished free and conjugated IAA, TAA/YUCCA order, DAO oxidation of conjugates, carrier mechanisms, TIR1 molecular glue and ARF regulation, shoot acid growth versus rapid root responses, differential tropisms, branching crosstalk and root initiation/emergence. All 51 answer choices and explanations checked; numerical examples and numerical answers recalculated. Hypothetical data explicitly identified.
editorial_review: Separate inspection of progression from classical observations to physiology and experimental reasoning, terminology, narrative, captions, comparisons, misconception rationales, practice and mastery. Rebalanced answer positions; corrected branching schematic and restored figure zoom/table styling.
deductions: Scientific accuracy: 1 for unavoidable simplification of context-dependent responses and models.
Pedagogy: 1 for density of advanced mechanism passages.
Illustrations: 1 for schematic rather than anatomically detailed drawings.
Assessment: 1 for some foundational distractors being less challenging.
Reader accessibility: 1 for absence of interactive mobile and screen-reader execution tests.
